proof_corrections: Fubini step: J0 changes sign, so 'everything is nonnegative / Tonelli' is false, and the crude bound |J0|<=1 gives the divergent int w(a)/(2a) da (log at a->0). Fix: Tonelli on |integrand| with the a-integral first gives int |J0(kr)|/(1+r0 k) dk < inf since |J0(x)|=O(x^-1/2); then Fubini.

Shorter independent route B: DLMF 11.5.2, H0(x)-Y0(x) = (2/pi) int_0^inf e^{-xu}(1+u^2)^{-1/2} du, makes V completely monotone in r; sqrt(t) is Bernstein, so V(sqrt t) is CM in t. CM is thus immediate from a textbook formula.

Constants of the proposed route are correct: V-hat = 2pi/(k(1+r0 k)), w(a) = (1/r0) erfcx(sqrt(a)/r0), Weber factor e^{-r^2/(4a)}/(2a). The Gradshteyn-Ryzhik equation number for the Hankel integral was not verified (identity checked numerically).

The jellium/renormalised energy relevant to TMD Wigner crystals is NOT covered.
